g.text: Hexapod V2 Hardware Bus Clocking & Phase-Stagger Strategy

ul.li: BCLK (Bit Clock): 705.6 kHz (22,050 Hz * 16 bits * 2 channels) on GPIO 40
LRC / WS (Word Select): 22.05 kHz Left/Right Framing on GPIO 39
DIN (Data Out): Serial Little-Endian PCM stream on GPIO 38
Phase Stagger Formula: ON_Tick = LocalChannel * 150, OFF_Tick = ON_Tick + PulseWidthTicks
Anti-Brownout: Staggers inductive servo motor inrush currents across time.
Non-Wrapping Safety: Maximum tick index (15 * 150) + 490 = 2740 is strictly less than the 4096 counter limit.
